ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 75% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the main body and 25% high-intensity (white) pixels localized at distal tips and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity white contiguous blobs at the distal tips of both lobes; a distinct circular ring-shaped high-contrast feature on the upper-right lobe; numerous small, high-intensity punctate spots scattered across the central dark region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped notch with an acute angle of approximately 40 degrees relative to the vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys ranging from 5 to 15 pixels) across the entire upper trailing edge, with the most aggressive peaks occurring on the outer thirds of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch extending outwards and upwards towards the tips, terminating in sharp, slightly recurved distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular high-intensity pixel groups located at both distal tips; a singular, highly defined white circular ring (donut shape) on the inner-right lobe adjacent to the notch.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of 4-6 parallel, vertical high-intensity linear scratches visible on the dark pigmented surface immediately flanking the central notch region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant semi-circular indentation or tissue loss on the lower-left margin; distinct ring-shaped scarring on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The 'donut' ring mark on the upper-right lobe is a highly unique visual identifier not typical of standard mottling patterns.
